package student

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type targetMasteryReaderStub struct {
	repository.TargetMasteryReader
	items []domain.StudentTargetMastery
}

func (stub targetMasteryReaderStub) ListStudentTargetMastery(
	context.Context,
	string,
	[]domain.LearningTargetRef,
) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error) {
	return stub.items, nil
}

func TestGetTargetMasteryPreservesOrderAndProjectsUnknown(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	first := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}
	second := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap", Version: "v1"}
	useCase := GetTargetMastery{Mastery: targetMasteryReaderStub{items: []domain.StudentTargetMastery{
		{
			StudentID:     studentID,
			Target:        second,
			State:         domain.TargetMasteryApplied,
			EvidenceCount: 1,
			PolicyVersion: domain.MasteryPolicyVersion,
		},
	}}}

	got, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), studentID, []domain.LearningTargetRef{first, second})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Handle returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if len(got) != 2 || got[0].Target.Key != first.Key || got[0].State != domain.TargetMasteryUnknown {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected unknown projection: %+v", got)
	}
	if got[1].Target.Key != second.Key || got[1].State != domain.TargetMasteryApplied {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected stored projection: %+v", got)
	}
}

func TestGetTargetMasteryRejectsInvalidInput(t *testing.T) {
	useCase := GetTargetMastery{Mastery: targetMasteryReaderStub{}}
	if _, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "not-a-uuid", []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected invalid student id error")
	}
	if _, err := useCase.Handle(context.Background(), "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", nil); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected empty targets error")
	}
}
